label: lem:mvt
title: Mean Value Theorem
statement: Let $G : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous on $[a,b]$ and differentiable on $(a,b)$ with $a < b$. Then there exists $c \in (a,b)$ such that $G'(c) = (G(b) - G(a))/(b - a)$. In Mathlib this is \texttt{exists\_hasDerivAt\_eq\_slope}.
proof: This is a standard Mathlib result (\texttt{exists\_hasDerivAt\_eq\_slope}).
